{"markdown":"# Issues Memo — FX Platform Licence Agreement

**To:** Deal team 
**From:** In-house counsel (Customer side) 
**Re:** Verified playbook findings and redline positions 
**Comment prefix in redline:** `[Playbook]`

---

## Executive summary

We reviewed the Agreement against the playbook and verified 18 findings: **13 deviations or gaps** (three of them critical) and **five compliant clauses**. The risk profile is heavily one-sided.

The critical cluster concerns risk allocation and ownership. Indemnity runs one way only — Article XII is a broad Licensee indemnity in favour of Licensor, with no Licensor indemnity anywhere, and Article XIII(a) expressly disclaims Licensor liability for infringement while Article XIII(b) caps Licensor at one half of amounts paid. The same Article XIII is the only cap in the Agreement, leaving our liability wholly uncapped with no carve-outs. On IP, Article III vests all right, title and interest in Licensor, and the "Derivative Work" definition sweeps in the customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), leaving us with only a terminable non-exclusive Field-of-Use licence.

The high-severity cluster concerns our ability to stay in and to get out: no Licensee termination-for-convenience right in a 36-month term; a unilateral Licensor option to extend for a further seven years; a blanket bar on Licensee assignment coupled with automatic termination on our change of control; and a licence grant that reaches neither our Affiliates nor a successor. Medium items include an unlimited, no-notice audit right, a three-year one-way non-solicit covering all Vendor personnel, an Article XXII right of first refusal on a sale or merger of Licensee, an "AS IS" disclaimer with no affirmative warranty, and no post-termination transition assistance or data return.

On the positive side, exclusivity, non-compete, minimum-commitment, liquidated-damages and governing-law provisions all meet our preferred position and require no redline. Pricing is usage-based and clean of best-price undertakings.

---

## Findings

| # | Severity | Rule | Status | Section | Position / proposal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Critical | INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Insert Licensor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, remedies and 3x annual fees super-cap, and conform Article XIII so it does not negate the indemnity. |
| 2 | Critical | IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data | Deviation | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Article VII(b) customization work, and limit any Licensor licence in our data to processing to provide the services. |
| 3 | Critical | LOL-CAP — Limitation of liability | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Make the cap mutual at 12 months' fees and place indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap. |
| 4 | High | ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control | Deviation | GENERAL PROVISIONS | Add Licensee affiliate/successor carve-out, add a Licensor-side assignment restriction, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control. |
| 5 | High | LICENSE — Licence grant scope | Deviation | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | Extend the licence to Affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition. |
| 6 | High | RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice | Deviation | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | Renewal only by mutual written agreement, in place of Licensor's unilateral seven-year extension option. |
| 7 | High | T4C — Termination for convenience | Deviation | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | Add a Licensee convenience right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the term. |
| 8 | High | EXCLUSIVITY — Exclusivity binding Customer | Compliant | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us; meets preferred position. No redline. |
| 9 | High | LD — Liquidated damages payable by Customer | Compliant | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | No liquidated damages, penalty or minimum/early-termination fee; fees are usage-based. No redline. |
| 10 | High | NONCOMPETE — Non-compete on Customer | Compliant | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | No restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build; meets preferred position. No redline. |
| 11 | Medium | AUDIT — Audit rights against Customer | Deviation | 50+ US$5.00 | Add frequency, notice, business-hours, confidentiality, off-site and no-system-access limits; leave auditor selection and the 5% cost shift untouched. |
| 12 | Medium | MFN — Most-favoured-nation obligations | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Strike Article XXII's right-of-first-refusal mechanic and its tail sentence, leaving only a negation of the matching right. |
| 13 | Medium | NOSOLICIT — Non-solicitation binding Customer | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Narrow the one-way three-year non-solicit to a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services. |
| 14 | Medium | WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration | Deviation | WARRANTY DISCLAIMER | Add express software/services warranty with repair, replacement or refund remedy and carve it out of the "AS IS" disclaimer. |
| 15 | Medium | TRANSITION — Transition assistance and data return | Missing | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Insert transition assistance and Licensee Data return/deletion obligations in Article XXI. |
| 16 | Medium | GOVLAW — Governing law and venue | Compliant | GENERAL PROVISIONS | New York law; exclusive New York state and federal courts; no arbitration. Meets preferred position. No redline. |
| 17 | Medium | MINCOMMIT — Minimum purchase commitments | Compliant | § II LICENSE GRANT AND RESTRICTIONS I. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that: | No minimum, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic; volume band starts at zero. No redline. |
| 18 | Low | INSURANCE — Vendor insurance | Missing | GENERAL PROVISIONS | Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) in General Provisions. |

---

## Walk-away items

The following findings sit in walk-away territory under the playbook and, in our view, cannot be signed as drafted:

1. **INDEMN** — No Vendor IP indemnity anywhere, combined with a one-way Licensee indemnity in Article XII and an express Licensor disclaimer of infringement liability in Article XIII(a). Fallback ask: Licensor IP indemnity with modification/combination/specification exclusions and procure–modify–replace–refund remedies, subject to a 3x annual fees super-cap, carved out of Article XIII(a) and (b) only so far as necessary.
2. **LOL-CAP** — One-sided cap; Licensor capped at one half of amounts paid (effectively below six months' fees) with Licensee uncapped and no carve-outs. Fallback ask: mutual 12-month cap plus the four carve-outs.
3. **ASSIGN** — Blanket bar on Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reciprocal Licensor restriction, plus automatic termination of all licences on our change of control under Article XX(a).
4. **RENEWAL** — Licensor's unilateral seven-year extension option with no non-renewal window for us.
5. **T4C** — No Licensee convenience right at all in a 36-month Initial Period, and no refund mechanic.
6. **AUDIT** — Unlimited audits on no prior notice, with no business-hours, confidentiality or system-access protections.
7. **MFN** — Article XXII right to match any third-party offer for our assets or control, unlimited in scope and running for the whole term.
8. **NOSOLICIT** — One-way 36-month non-solicit reaching all Licensor and Affiliate personnel.
9. **TRANSITION** — Our licences end immediately with a five-day ship-back and officer's certificate, and nothing obliges Licensor to return or export our data.
10. **WARRANTY** — Pure "AS IS" supply with an express disclaimer that nonconformity to Documentation will be corrected.
11. **INSURANCE** — No coverage covenant at all, where Licensor hosts the platform and receives our market data and trading orders.

**Also below fallback (not walk-away):** IP ownership of the Article VII(b) customizations we pay for, and the licence grant's failure to reach our Affiliates or a successor.

---

## Next steps

1. **Confirm the walk-away list with the business.** We should agree internally, before the first exchange, that items 1–3 above (indemnity, liability cap, change-of-control/assignment) are signature conditions.
2. **Issue the redline in one pass**, drafted to the fallback where noted (indemnity, liability cap, licence scope, non-solicit) and to the preferred position where the fallback edit is no shorter (audit guardrails, MFN deletion, transition, termination for convenience).
3. **Sequence the negotiation** around the three critical items; the medium items (audit, non-solicit, warranty, transition, insurance) are drafted as short surgical edits and should be presented as a package for acceptance rather than clause-by-clause debate.
4. **Hold the identified fallbacks in reserve:** 90-day transition assistance with 30-day data export; 12-month mutual non-solicit; annual audit on 15 days' notice.
5. **Flag two drafting points for correction on the technical pass**, not as issues: the reference in the fee-calculation provision to amounts payable by "the Licensor" (evidently intended as Licensee), and the conflict between Licensor's unilateral extension option and the Term provisions contemplating extension only by mutual written agreement.
6. **Re-run verification** after Vendor's markup; three findings were repaired in this cycle (IP, ASSIGN, MFN, NOSOLICIT) and should be re-checked for orphaned cross-references."}
